column4: Front-panel key scan. Reads ADC_A0/A1 (0xFF09/0xFF0A) with 3-try settle loop, bands -> key mask in XDATA dbad (scratch), P3.0 low -> bit0. Returns debounced mask (2 identical scans, e205). See docs/reversing/realtek-rtd/buttons.md.
|prev - new| < 5 style compare of two ADC_A0 samples (via 0x002e abs helper); CY set = stable.
Same as 3ab6 for the ADC_A1 sample.
Key poll tick: skip if e207!=0; e208->e209 (prev), key_scan_adc -> e208, key_power_edge, else key_event_dispatch.
Switch on key mask e208: 02->idx0, 04->idx1, 08->idx2, 10->idx3, 18->idx3, 20->idx4 (only if e14e/e14f==0); calls key_post_event(R5=idx,R7=mask).
Writes key index to e151 (OSD key event); on key change checks long-press (641e); else auto-repeat via timer 1 (500 units).
Power key (P3.0 low, mask bit0) press edge (e208 vs e209): banked call 0x0f39(1|2) toggles power; CY=1 = handled.
For mask 0x10/0x18 arms timer id 0xd with 0x0BB8 (3000 units) = long press; returns CY=1.
Clears e152 bit4, cancels timers 0xb,0xd,0xe.
Sets e067 bits 0/1 and banked-calls 0x0dc5 when e208 == 0x03 (0x18/0x14 compares unreachable from 5942).
Called when ADC/pin read no key: copies 8 bytes from code 0xFF:3067 to dbb4, 57f3 check; returns dbbe. Role unknown (non-ADC key source?).
Returns CY=1 when key scan allowed (e152 bit1 handling, arms timer 2 = 10 units).
Key event index written by key_post_event (0..4); consumed by bank0 OSD handlers (cases 1,2,3,6 via DEC chain); 7/8 used as idle markers by key_poll.
Key scan flags: bit0/1 scan busy, bit2 repeat, bit3 held, bit4 longpress armed.
Last debounced key mask; same value twice = accepted.
Current key mask (bit0 P3.0 power, 1/2/4/8/0x10/0x20).
Previous key mask.
Toggles osd_en (0x3A02[0]) from bit03; on disable first clears 0x0094[7:5,3:2] (SRAM CS rule, docs/reversing/realtek-rtd/osd.md); on enable calls 0x0855(8) twice.
R7=0x94 write-option (bytesel[7:5], sram_sel[3:2]), R2:R3=word addr -> 0x0090/0x0091, data DC3F -> 0x0092. Single OSD byte write.
R5 -> 0x94 bytesel, R2:R3 -> 0x90/0x91, returns 0x0092 (read-back).
Loops writing 3-byte words (DBB7,DBB8,DBB9) to 0x0092 after osd addr setup with option 0xE0 (window SRAM); count in DBBA via helper 0x1312.
Writes font_base[14:0] (3A17[6:4], 3A0E, 3A0D[3:0]) from DBBB:DBBC; R4==0 also fs_base (3A0C, 3A0D[7:4]) + row_base0 3A19/3A1B/3A1C, R4==1 base1 set 3A1A/3A1D.
0x006E=0x80|R7 (lut_acc_en+index), R5/R3 then DBBA byte to 0x006F (COLOR_LUT_PORT), clears 0x006E.

R7*3 + 0x2FB3 -> DPTR, returns 16-bit offset R6:R7 from bytes 1..2 of the 3-byte (seg=0xFF,hi,lo) entry; 15 entries -> 9 distinct 197-B blobs at 0x28C6..0x2FB2 (flash 0x628C6..0x62FB2; ent~7.0 = VLC glyph-set candidate). Called only from 0x4e55.

Thunk 0x106b. Streams VLC-compressed glyph bitmaps from SPI flash into OSD font SRAM. Flash src addr formed as DC3C:R2:R1 where DC3C=DBB7=SFR 0xFFFF (PBANK current bank), R2:R1=caller far-ptr offset. DBB8:DBB9 = OSD-SRAM DEST word (not flash). Selects font-set variant (DBBC 1->0xC5 2->0x85 3->0x44). 0x42ff: osd_compression_en 0x3A17|=1 ON, then &=0xFC OFF -> stream is VLC. docs/boot-logo.md.

SPI-flash read by absolute 24-bit addr SCA_INF_BWR_ADRH:ADRM:ADRL (0xFFF6/7/8) = DC3C:R2(param2):R1(param1); page reg 0x9F=PAGE_SEL=DC3D; count 0xFFF9/A=R4:R5; ctrl 0xFFF3. Only flash reader on the font-download path. docs/boot-logo.md.
Sets OSD font-SRAM write target: FUN_CODE_66ab(0xE0, R6:R7=DBB8:DBB9) programs port 0x94 write-option + 0x90/0x91 addr. DBB8:DBB9 is the SRAM destination word, NOT a flash address. docs/boot-logo.md.
Programs OSD access port 0x94 (write-option bytesel/sram_sel from R5/R7) then 0x6883 sets addr port 0x90. Called by 6868.
0x3A0B (f_dl orient/rotation) = (0x3A0B & 0x3A) | DBBD. DBBD = font-set variant byte.
Loads R3:R2:R1 = DBB2:DBB3:DBB4 (the far-pointer seg:mid:low set by 0x4272 entry from caller R3:R2:R1).
Alt font-download site: LCALL ptr_table_lookup 0x661d to pick one of nine 197-B glyph-set blobs (bank6 0x628C6-0x62FB2) then stream. Parallel to the 4 composer sites.

column1: # --- Phase 2 [re-agent] rows (bank 6). Columns: addr, name, type, comment, status, confidence. ---

# Finding: bank 6 holds NO menu tree / item handlers / strings. It is the Realtek OSD+colour lib, the RTD2014Key.c key/IR code, OsdFunc helpers and a few kernel funcs (SDK sources in tmp/sdcc-port/src). Menu state machine lives in other banks (reads g_stOsdInfo.usOsdState = e14e:e14f).

# Finding: Keil C51 bit fields are LSB-first (first-declared field = LOW bits), not MSB-first as in docs/re-full-reversal.md. Evidence: SysColorHandler tests (e22e & 0x1f)==3 = GET_MODE_STATE()==_MODE_STATUS_ACTIVE (b5ModeState declared first); Phase 1 g_stColorInfo e231 & 0xf8 clears b3ColorSpace (first field). The power nibble test >>4==3 is then PowerStatus, not PowerAction.

column4: RTD2014OsdFunc.c OsdFuncApplyMap(w,h,color): row cmds (ScalerOsdCommandAllByte 0x80,0x11,w), end cmd, font-select/table start -> e1e6/e1e8, char cmd 0x4C fill, g_ucOsdWidth e1ea / Height e1e5, col max e242, DoubleFunction(e14c bit5).
RTD2014OsdFunc.c OsdFuncChangeColor1Bit non-rotated path: per row CharCommandByteSeries BYTE0 (0x4C|fontFrom) then BYTE2 colour, addr += g_ucOsdWidth (e1ea).
RTD2014OsdFunc.c OsdFuncClearOsd non-rotated path: per row CharCommandByteSeries 0x4C BYTE0 + 0x00 BYTE1, addr += g_ucOsdWidth.
RTD2014OsdFunc.c OsdFuncBlending: ScalerOsdVerticalStartSelect(0), ScalerOsdWindow7SpecialFunction(6), transparency type via common helper 0x2020.
RTD2014OsdPalette.c OsdPaletteLoadPigment: 16 entries x 3 bytes read from far code ptr, index = palette*16 (arg<<4), each via osd_lut_write (ScalerOsdSetColorPalette tail).
RTD2014OsdPalette.c OsdPaletteSelectPalette: arg 0 -> code 0xFF:3010 (_PALETTE_RTD_LOGO), 1 -> 0xFF:2FE0 (_PALETTE_MAIN_MENU), then OsdPaletteLoadPigment(index0).
16 x RGB main-menu palette (bank 6 flash 0x62FE0), used by OsdPaletteSelectPalette(1).
16 x RGB logo palette (bank 6 flash 0x63010), used by OsdPaletteSelectPalette(0).
RTD2014Key.c RTDKeyHoldKeyCheck: if e152 bit4 (KEY_HOLD) then key_prev 02/04/08/10 -> message idx 0/1/2/3 into e151, then hold-timer cancel.

ScalerIR.c EXINT0 handler: IR_CR2[2] && IR_SR3[1:0]; if g_bIRReceived or IR_SR3[6:4] clear flags else copy IR_RP0..3 + RP2_0..3 into g_pucIRCode e1ee..e1f5, set received flag g_bIRReceived (bit _7_1).
ScalerIR.c ScalerIRHWModeGetData: if received flag copy 8 bytes e1ee..e1f5 to caller buffer, clear flag. Caller = RTDIRKeyScan (key_alt_source_poll 5154).
ScalerIR.c ScalerIRHWModeDecoder: 4 burst writes to page 0x23 regs 0xA0 (10 B), 0xAE (6 B), 0xD0 (8 B), 0xDA (8 B, SDK uses table-3 length for the 4th too).
ScalerIR.c ScalerIRHWModeInitial: IR_SF2:SF3 = 0x00B1 (XTAL sample div), IR_SR3 |= 0x7F, IR_CR2 |= 5.
ScalerIR.c ScalerIRHWModeClockSel: 0 -> SF2:SF3 = 0x00B1 (XTAL), 1 -> 0x015D (IOSC).
ScalerReg.c: (57+4*font width)*M2PLL*2/(g_ulDClkFreq e010..e013 * flash div * mcu div) - 2, doubled when OSD double-H, clamped 0xFF. Used by ScalerBurstWrite (4445) OSD mode.
RL6449_Series_TimerFunction.c: switch on event: 0x10/0x20 -> IRQ_CTRL1 bit4/2, 0xFF -> M2_STATUS1=0xF7 + IRQ_CTRL1 + STATUS1=0xFF, 1/4 -> M1 or M2 STATUS1 by FtoP status.
RL6449_Series_TimerFunction.c: event 0x10 (DEN_START) with IRQ_CTRL1[3] set -> clear flag e24a else ClrEventStatusbyReg.
RL6449_Series_TimerFunction.c: event 0x10 with IRQ_CTRL1[3] -> return flag e24a else ScalerTimerGetEventStatusbyReg.

RL6449_Series_Pinshare.c ScalerPinshareInitial: PIN_SHARE_CTRL10/11, DDC pin switches (0x11,5,7), bulk CTRL14..CTRL96 fills (outlined 55xx helpers), DDC drive current, then ScalerPinshareConfig(AC_ON) = 5d88(0). Pin values are vendor board data.
RL6449_Series_Pinshare.c ScalerPinsharePowerOnReset: off-region CTRL43..CTRL80 (0x1013..) fill via outlined helpers 55ba/560d/55ef.
RL6449_Series_Pinshare.c: PIN_DRIVING_CTRL02[7:5] (arg3==0, SPI clk) or [4:2] (arg3==1, SI/SO/CEB) = drive level 0..5 (3.0..5.5 mA); level 0 -> 0x40/0x08.
RL6449_Series_Pinshare.c ScalerPinshareAdjustConfig case _CONFIG_PIN_195: PIN_SHARE_CTRL91[2:0]: arg 0->0 GPI, 1->2, 2->1 (GPO od/pp), 0xB->4, 0xC->3 (PWM4 od/pp). Specialised copy.
ScalerCommonPower.c ScalerPowerXtalPower(on): XTAL_CTRL0[7], pad drive XTAL_CTRL1[4:3], 6 ms wait (07e3) on power-up.
RL6449_Series_PLL.c ScalerPLLDPTxPLLReset: DPTX_CMU5[5] clear + 2 ms delay, DPTX_PHY_CTRL0 &= 0x6F (clear bit7,4).
ScalerADC.c ScalerADCBandgap(bit): on -> ADC_POWER bit3, SOG_CTRL bit3; off -> ADC_POWER bit4, SOG_CTRL bit1.
ScalerSync.c ScalerSyncAdcPowerProc(action): bandgap on (4..5) vs ApllPowerDown + bandgap off (3,6,7,8); VGA-only parts compiled out.
SysColor.c: ScalerColorDCCGetDataReadyStatus -> Clr -> ready flag (_6_0), run user handler, clear flag.
SysColor.c: DCR ready (DCR_CTRL) -> clr, ready flag (_5_7), DCR refresh disable/enable via ScalerColorDCRDataRefreshControl, DCR_ADDRESS_PORT=1.
SysColor.c: if GET_MODE_STATE()==_MODE_STATUS_ACTIVE ((e22e & 0x1F)==3) call DCC histogram + DCR handlers.

RTD2014 g_stOsdInfo base: +3 usOsdState = e14e:e14f (zeroed on power-on key, gates key 0x20), +6 ucOsdKeyMessage = e151, +7 ucOsdKeyControl = e152 (bit0 scan ready, 1 scan start, 2 repeat start, 3 repeat enable, 4 key hold; same as RTD2014Include.h). e14c bit5 = double-size (layout of byte +1 differs from SDK).
OsdFuncApplyMap width (words); x12 = pixel width (56d2), added per row in OsdFuncChangeColor1Bit/ClearOsd.
OsdFuncApplyMap height (rows); x18 = pixel height in ScalerOsdDrawWindow.
OsdFuncApplyMap: height+1 (big-endian pair e1e6:e1e7).
OsdFuncApplyMap: g_usFontSelectStart + width*height (e1e8:e1e9).
SET_OSD_MAPA_COL_MAX(width) in OsdFuncApplyMap; used by ScalerOsdSramAddressCount.
Map-B col max, read by ScalerOsdSramAddressCount when sram addr >= 100.
GET_OD_USE_BIT: 75 (0x4B) / 60 (0x3C) compared in ScalerODCompressionSetting, used by ScalerODSetFIFO.
DEN_START event flag read/cleared by ScalerTimerGetEventStatus/ClrEventStatus (612a/6152).
IR HW receive buffer filled by ScalerIRHWModeIntHandler_EXINT0, drained by ScalerIRHWModeGetData.
GET_MODE_STATE = e22e & 0x1F (LSB-first bit field); ==3 (_MODE_STATUS_ACTIVE) gates SysColorHandler.
GET_D_CLK_FREQ operand of ScalerBurstWriteTimeoutCal (5554), 32-bit big-endian e010..e013.
